description: EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program (GHGRP) reported emissions for one facility by year, from EPA Envirofacts (CO2e summed across gases per year, as published). Uses the GHGRP facility id (e.g. 1000001). Facility search and sector breakdowns are not included. Related tools on this server, for a different need: energy_epa_echo_enforcement when you need EPA ECHO summary for one US state: counts of active. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

facilityId.description: GHGRP facility id, digits only, e.g. 1000001
